command: import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile; directory=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(); root=pathlib.Path(directory.name); base=root/"base.json"; override=root/"override.json"; bad=root/"bad.json"; base.write_text(json.dumps({"nested":{"keep":1,"delete":2},"items":[1]})); override.write_text(json.dumps({"nested":{"delete":None,"add":3},"items":[2]})); bad.write_text("{bad"); cases=[("layered",[str(base),str(override)],0),("base-only",[str(base)],0),("invalid-json",[str(bad)],2),("unreadable",[str(root/"missing.json")],2),("argument-count",[],2)]; results=[(label,subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","configkit",*args],capture_output=True,text=True),expected) for label,args,expected in cases]; [print(json.dumps({"case":label,"status":result.returncode,"stdout":result.stdout,"stderr":result.stderr})) for label,result,expected in results]; assert all(result.returncode==expected and (not result.stderr if expected==0 else bool(result.stderr) and not result.stdout and "Traceback" not in result.stderr) for label,result,expected in results); assert json.loads(results[0][1].stdout)=={"nested":{"keep":1,"add":3},"items":[2]}; digest=hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path("LOCAL_NOTES.txt").read_bytes()).hexdigest(); assert digest=="3cc1f3ffdd22f0f42c6449b2be0fea9b2660da6c2ddc99d705ddb562029d4e26"; print("LOCAL_NOTES.txt unchanged:",digest)
